title: The Broken Hammer
text: The head of a great smith's hammer lies split in two on the forge floor, each half the size of a child. Both halves are still warm, and humming, and when you hold them apart they lean toward each other like lovers.

options.label: Take a half each, and keep them well apart.

outcomes.text: Heavy, and warm in the pack, leaning always toward the other half, as if it is pining.

options.label: The strongest pushes the halves together, to make the hammer whole again.

outcomes.text: They fuse with a ring like a great bell, and the hammer is whole, and glad.
They fuse with a blast that throws them across the forge, arms first.

options.label: Bury the halves far apart, so they can never find each other again.

outcomes.text: The humming stops, and something deep in the forge settles, like a sigh.
